summary: Woori Financial Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 First Quarter Earnings Release Conference to be held on April 24, 2026. The filing details the agenda, date, time, format (live audio webcast and conference call), language options (Korean and English), and participation instructions. This is a routine earnings conference notice with no special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or management change. It is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer regarding an upcoming earnings call.
